data.subject: larger headquarters and finance operations
data.body:
Hi Sendil,

Zipline recently relocated to a larger headquarters in preparation for an expansion of drone-delivery operations. Alongside expanding sites with Walmart, that scale of operational growth tends to bring heavy purchase requisitions and added touchpoints across the month-end close.

Having led finance at Tesla, you know how quickly back-office overhead can compound. Block removed 75% of human touchpoints in the accounting close.

Are you open to a 20-minute call to explore how we could support Zipline?

[Your name]
